label: PCF85063A Logger Heartbeat Demo
info: An Inject node fires every 10 seconds, triggering the periph-pcf85063a node to read the current date/time and the oscillator-stop flag. A one-shot Inject node (firing shortly after deploy) sends msg.payload.datetime built from the host's Date.now(), synchronizing the RTC to the host clock. The node is configured with a 1-minute pulsed countdown timer (source clock 1 Hz, value 60); each time it fires, the node emits a separate {source: "timer"} message, which a Function node turns into a "still alive" log line — showing the interrupt-driven path alongside the polled read in one flow.

name: build datetime from host clock
